Exercise checker for the mirtverse labs

Source: R/labs.R
lab_checker.Rd

The checker the labs pass to learnr::tutorial_options(). It runs an exercise's -check chunk in the environment the student's code produced. Inside that chunk, lab_need(condition, message) fails the exercise with message when condition is not TRUE, and .result holds the value of the student's last expression. If every check passes, the exercise is marked correct and the chunk's last value (when it is a string) is shown as the feedback.

Usage

lab_checker(
  label = NULL,
  user_code = NULL,
  solution_code = NULL,
  check_code = NULL,
  envir_result = NULL,
  evaluate_result = NULL,
  envir_prep = NULL,
  last_value = NULL,
  stage = NULL,
  ...
)

Arguments

label, user_code, solution_code, check_code, envir_result, evaluate_result, envir_prep, last_value, stage

supplied by learnr.

...

ignored.

Value

A list in the format learnr expects.
